{{Quote|We're hemorrhaging more mercs every day to the Republic. Nova Guard, Crimson Brotherhood... this keeps up, we'll lose our foothold, our entire slave trade. The mercenaries need to realize the consequences of a Republic partnership. We need to send them a message, written in blood.|[[Eliss Pim]]|<ref name="TOR:AMftM" />}}
The '''Nova Guard''' was a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:AMftM" />
{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nova Guard mercenaries appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as enemies for Imperial players on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="TOR:AMftM" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
